snippet.title: Lootdeck - Offical Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist Lootdeck on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4972950/Lootdeck/?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=trailer&utm_campaign=announcement

Lootdeck is a tactical roguelite deckbuilder deeply integrated with tabletop combat mechanics. Every item you equip adds new action cards to your deck. Craft your own unique playstyle through the loot you find, outsmart enemies on a tactical grid, and delve deeper into an ever-changing dungeon.

Studio: MadMage Studio
Platform: PC (Steam)
Release Date: TBA

#Lootdeck #IndieGame #Deckbuilder #indiegames #gametrailers
